none.$description: No elevation - flat surfaces, default state

raised.$description: Subtle lift - cards, buttons with depth

overlay.$description: High lift - modals, dialogs, action sheets

sticky.$description: Fixed headers, sticky navigation, bottom bars

xs.$description: The smallest viewport, where mobile-first styles start.

sm.$description: Breakpoint for large phones in landscape and small tablets.

md.$description: Breakpoint for tablets; below it, mobile layouts apply, such as a fullscreen Modal.

lg.$description: Breakpoint for small desktops and landscape tablets.

2xl.$description: Breakpoint for wide desktops; layouts can add columns from here.

full.$description: 1: fully opaque (the enabled counterpart of disabled).

hover.$description: Content that fades to answer hover, such as a clickable card's image.

pressed.$description: Content that fades while pressed, one step further than hover.

hover.$description: State layer for a hovered solid fill: its content colour mixed in at 8%, as in Material 3 (decision 0048).

pressed.$description: State layer for a pressed solid fill: its content colour mixed in at 12% (decision 0048).

body.$description: UI text (Inter). Use a typography style where one fits; this is for components that set the family on its own.

xs.$description: Smallest text size: captions, metadata and small labels.

sm.$description: Secondary text size: labels, compact controls and supporting copy.

md.$description: Body text size: paragraphs, input values and most controls.

lg.$description: One step larger than body text on the type scale.

xl.$description: Two steps larger than body text on the type scale.

none.$description: 1 (unitless): line box equals the font size. For single-line glyphs such as avatar initials and count indicators.

tight.$description: Line height for compact multi-line text, such as Alert and CodeBlock.

normal.$description: Line height for body text and multi-line entry, such as TextArea.

tighter.$description: Tightest tracking, for the largest headings: display and h1.

tight.$description: Slightly tighter tracking for mid-size headings, h2 to h4.

wide.$description: Wide tracking for small uppercase labels, such as SearchField section headers.

regular.$description: 400. Body text, captions, most UI text.

medium.$description: 500. Subheadings (h5, h6, subtitle), buttons, emphasis within UI text.

semibold.$description: 600. Labels and short titles that need more weight than medium (label, Alert title).

bold.$description: 700. Headings (display to h4), overline, strong indicators such as the required-field asterisk.

default.$description: Hairline in the default border colour: dividers and decorative outlines, such as Breadcrumbs, CodeBlock and Divider. 1.53:1 on white, so never a control edge (decision 0025).

focus.$description: The focus ring every component draws, with border.focusOffset; never blue (decision 0029).

thin.$description: Hairline border: dividers, control edges and rings.

thick.$description: Thick border: focus rings, emphasised outlines and selected states.

focusOffset.$description: Gap between an element and its focus ring; negate it to inset the ring inside the element.

input-hover.$description: Firm hairline that must read as a boundary, such as a hovered text input.

pointerTarget.$description: Minimum pointer target for a control that's smaller to look at: its invisible hit area (WCAG 2.5.8, decision 0039). On touch screens, use touchTarget.

touchTarget.$description: Minimum height of a tappable row or control on touch screens.

sm.$description: Minimum height of small controls: small Buttons and IconButtons, buttons inside fields (decision 0034).

md.$description: Minimum height of medium controls: the default IconButton, medium Buttons (decision 0034).

lg.$description: Minimum height of large controls: text fields, Dropdown, SearchField, the default Button (decision 0034).

sm.$description: Width of a small Modal, and the default width or height of a Sheet.

md.$description: Width of a medium overlay panel, such as a medium Modal.

lg.$description: Width of a large overlay panel, such as a large Modal.

small.$description: Height of a small label: StatusLabel small and Tag small (decision 0018).

medium.$description: Height of a medium label and every chip: StatusLabel, Tag, CategoryLabel (0018, 0035).

large.$description: Height of a large label: CategoryLabel large (decision 0018).

maxHeight.$description: Tallest a floating menu grows before it scrolls: Dropdown, SearchField.

xs.$description: The smallest icon size, for dense inline indicators.

sm.$description: Icons in compact controls, such as Alert's dismiss icon and small icon buttons.

md.$description: Icons beside body text, such as Alert's severity icon.

lg.$description: The Icon component's default size; also list item icons.

xl.$description: Extra-large standalone icons, such as feature illustrations.

2xl.$description: The largest icon size, for prominent standalone icons.

sm.$description: Small avatar, in dense lists and tables.

lg.$description: Large avatar, in headers and cards.

100.$description: Size step for thin bars: the TabBar scrollbar, the small ProgressBar.

200.$description: Size step for small marks: the Badge dot, the medium ProgressBar.

400.$description: Size step for compact indicators: the Badge count, the large ProgressBar.

500.$description: Size step for small boxes: the Checkbox box, TabBar count badges, small labels.

600.$description: Size step for the medium label height, used by chips and StatusLabel.

800.$description: Size step for compact rows and large labels, such as the Checkbox row.

1200.$description: Size step for headers and indents, such as the AccountCard header.

1500.$description: Size step for the comfortable ListItem expanded indent.

1800.$description: Size step for tall rows, such as the TransactionListItem minimum height.

2000.$description: Size step for small illustrations, such as the small EmptyState image.

3000.$description: Size step for medium illustrations and multi-line inputs: EmptyState, TextArea.

4500.$description: Size step for truncation widths, such as a Breadcrumbs label.

5000.$description: Size step for large illustrations, such as the large EmptyState image.

7500.$description: Size step for narrow column widths: AccountCard, EmptyState actions.

9000.$description: Size step for readable text widths, such as EmptyState copy.

10000.$description: Size step for compact panel widths, such as the EmptyState block.

19200.$description: Size step for wide content columns, such as CardLarge.

auto.$description: auto: lets the browser compute the space, such as margin: auto to centre or push an element.

default.$description: Primary text: body copy, labels and headings. 15.91:1 on white, 15.51:1 on the page.

inverse.$description: Text on dark or coloured fills, such as the primary, accent and danger Buttons. 15.51:1 on fill.emphasis.

disabled.$description: Text of disabled controls, translucent so it stays right on tinted surfaces. 1.53:1 on white: disabled text is exempt from the contrast minimum (WCAG 1.4.3), so never use it for text people need to read, including placeholders.

success.$description: Success text, such as InlineAlert success messages. 5.99:1 on white.

warning.$description: Warning text, such as InlineAlert warnings (0043: warning is yellow). 6.01:1 on white.

muted.$description: Secondary text: helper text, metadata, timestamps. 6.01:1 on white, and at least 4.5:1 on every background and fill step (decision 0040).

accent.$description: Blue text for links and selected items, in every state: the fill shows hover and pressed. Never decoration (0003). 6.00:1 on white.

danger.$description: Error text: field error messages, InlineAlert errors. 6.03:1 on white.

ai.$description: AI-generated content and agent actions, such as the label on proposed content (0046); always with the AI icon and a label, never colour alone (0043). 5.99:1 on white, 5.68:1 on the page.

serious.$description: Serious-warning text: between warning and danger (decisions 0043, 0045). 6.04:1 on white.

default.$description: Default border colour for dividers and decorative outlines only (decision 0040). 1.53:1 on white, below the 3:1 a control edge needs; use color.border.input for that (decision 0025).

success.$description: Green border for success outlines, such as an outlined success Alert. 3.18:1 on white (decision 0025).

warning.$description: Yellow border for warning outlines, such as an outlined warning Alert. 3.19:1 on white (decision 0025).

none.$description: An invisible border that keeps its width, so a borderless state takes the same space as a bordered one (for example Alert's borderless appearance, decision 0019).

input.$description: Resting edge of a control that must show where it is: text inputs, Dropdown, Checkbox. 3.19:1 on white and the page (decision 0025).

input-hover.$description: Edge of a hovered control, such as a hovered text input or Dropdown. 6.01:1 on white, a clear step from rest that stays apart from the focus ring.

focus.$description: The focus ring, and rings that mark the current item, such as on CardSmall (0029). 15.91:1 on white.

accent.$description: Blue border for selected items; never decoration (0003). 3.21:1 on white (decision 0025).

danger.$description: Border of an invalid field and other error outlines. 3.18:1 on white (decision 0025).

serious.$description: Orange border for serious-warning outlines. 3.21:1 on white (decision 0025).

ai.$description: Purple border for AI-generated content and agent actions, always with the AI icon and a label (0043). 3.20:1 on white.

default.$description: Default icon colour, matching text.default. 15.91:1 on white.

disabled.$description: Icons and other foreground marks in disabled controls, matching text.disabled. 1.53:1 on white.

inverse.$description: Icons on dark or coloured fills, matching text.inverse.

success.$description: Success icons, such as in Alert and EmptyState. 5.99:1 on white. (InlineAlert’s icon takes the text colour instead.)

warning.$description: Warning icons, such as in Alert. 6.01:1 on white. (InlineAlert’s icon takes the text colour instead.)

muted.$description: Secondary icons, such as list item and empty-state icons, matching text.muted. 6.01:1 on white.

accent.$description: Blue icons in links and selected items, in every state, matching color.text.accent. 6.00:1 on white.

danger.$description: Error icons, such as in Alert and EmptyState. 6.03:1 on white.

ai.$description: The AI icon on AI-generated content and agent actions (0043, 0046), next to its label. 5.99:1 on white, 5.68:1 on the page.

serious.$description: Serious-warning icons, matching color.text.serious. 6.04:1 on white.

gray.$description: Gray category (decision 0043: neutral, for uncategorised or "other"): the outline of an outlined CategoryLabel. 3.19:1 on white.

gray-strong.$description: Strong step of the gray category: the fill of a filled CategoryLabel, with white text at 6.01:1.

gray-text.$description: Text and icons of an outlined or minimal gray CategoryLabel. 6.01:1 on white, 5.37:1 on gray-muted.

gray-muted.$description: Light gray fill of a minimal CategoryLabel, behind the gray-text colour.

olive.$description: Olive category (decision 0043: no meaning): the outline of an outlined CategoryLabel. 3.18:1 on white.

olive-strong.$description: Strong step of the olive category: the fill of a filled CategoryLabel, with white text at 6.02:1.

olive-text.$description: Text and icons of an outlined or minimal olive CategoryLabel. 6.02:1 on white, 5.39:1 on olive-muted.

olive-muted.$description: Light olive fill of a minimal CategoryLabel, behind the olive-text colour.

periwinkle.$description: Periwinkle category (decision 0043: no meaning): the outline of an outlined CategoryLabel. 3.20:1 on white.

periwinkle-strong.$description: Strong step of the periwinkle category: the fill of a filled CategoryLabel, with white text at 6.00:1.

periwinkle-text.$description: Text and icons of an outlined or minimal periwinkle CategoryLabel. 6.00:1 on white, 5.37:1 on periwinkle-muted.

periwinkle-muted.$description: Light periwinkle fill of a minimal CategoryLabel, behind the periwinkle-text colour.

rose.$description: Rose category (decision 0043: no meaning): the outline of an outlined CategoryLabel. 3.20:1 on white.

rose-strong.$description: Strong step of the rose category: the fill of a filled CategoryLabel, with white text at 5.99:1.

rose-text.$description: Text and icons of an outlined or minimal rose CategoryLabel. 5.99:1 on white, 5.33:1 on rose-muted.

rose-muted.$description: Light rose fill of a minimal CategoryLabel, behind the rose-text colour.

magenta.$description: Magenta category (decision 0043: no meaning): the outline of an outlined CategoryLabel. 3.20:1 on white.

magenta-strong.$description: Strong step of the magenta category: the fill of a filled CategoryLabel, with white text at 6.02:1.

magenta-text.$description: Text and icons of an outlined or minimal magenta CategoryLabel. 6.02:1 on white, 5.38:1 on magenta-muted.

magenta-muted.$description: Light magenta fill of a minimal CategoryLabel, behind the magenta-text colour.

emphasis.$description: Strong near-black fill for the primary Button and IconButton and the emphasis Chip, with text.inverse on it (15.91:1). Hover and pressed mix in text.inverse at opacity.state (decision 0048).

muted.$description: Light grey fill for quiet grouped content, such as the default Chip. The resting fill step, so it shows on the page.

inverse.$description: Dark fill for inverse elements: a checked Checkbox, Modal and Sheet drag handles.

accent.$description: Blue fill for the accent Button and other deliberate highlights (0003), with text.inverse on it at 6.00:1.

accent-muted.$description: Light blue fill for selected items: a selected chip, tab or row (0016). Accent text on it is 5.37:1.

accent-muted-hover.$description: Fill of a hovered selected item, such as a selected filter chip.

accent-muted-pressed.$description: Fill of a pressed selected item, such as a selected filter chip.

accent-hover.$description: Blue fill of a hovered accent control: fill.accent with text.inverse mixed in at opacity.state.hover (decision 0048).

accent-pressed.$description: Blue fill of a pressed accent control: fill.accent with text.inverse mixed in at opacity.state.pressed (decision 0048).

danger.$description: Strong red fill for destructive actions, such as the danger Button, with text.inverse on it at 6.03:1.

danger-hover.$description: Fill of a hovered destructive control: fill.danger with text.inverse mixed in at opacity.state.hover (decision 0048).

danger-pressed.$description: Fill of a pressed destructive control: fill.danger with text.inverse mixed in at opacity.state.pressed (decision 0048).

danger-muted.$description: Light red tint behind error messages, such as an error Alert. Danger text on it is 5.39:1.

success.$description: Strong green fill for success states, such as a success indicator, with text.inverse on it at 5.99:1.

success-muted.$description: Light green tint behind success messages, such as a success Alert. Success text on it is 5.34:1.

warning.$description: Strong yellow fill for warning states, such as a warning indicator, with text.inverse on it at 6.01:1.

warning-muted.$description: Light yellow tint behind warning messages, such as a warning Alert. Warning text on it is 5.37:1.

disabled.$description: Fill of a disabled control, such as a disabled Button or Switch.

default.$description: Fill of a neutral control at rest, such as the secondary Button (decision 0040).

default-hover.$description: Fill of a hovered neutral control, such as the secondary Button.

default-pressed.$description: Fill of a pressed neutral control, such as the secondary Button.

none.$description: No fill, for controls without a background at rest: the naked Button and IconButton.

none-hover.$description: Hover tint for a fill-less control over any background, such as a chip close button.

none-pressed.$description: Pressed tint for a fill-less control over any background, such as a chip close button.

inverse-none-hover.$description: Hover tint for a fill-less element on a dark background, such as a count on a dark tab.

serious.$description: Strong orange fill for serious-warning states, with text.inverse on it at 6.04:1.

serious-muted.$description: Light orange tint behind serious-warning messages.

ai-muted.$description: Light purple tint behind AI-generated content and agent proposals, always with the AI icon and a label (0043).

data.$description: Colours for charts and other data display (decision 0043). Each chart type has its own set; a chart never mixes them, and every value or series also carries a label, sign or legend.

positive.$description: Good values and money in: gains, rises, credits. Always with a sign or arrow. 3.75:1 on white, the same step as negative so neither looks heavier.

negative.$description: Bad values and money out: losses, falls, debits. Always with a sign or arrow. 3.74:1 on white, 0.118 apart from positive under every kind of colour vision.

categorical.$description: Category series, in order, with no meaning; group more than four coloured series into other, or label them directly.

other.$description: The other or remaining series, always last and labelled. 3.19:1 on white.

balance.$description: A comparison with no good or bad, from olive through neutral grey to magenta.

1.$description: Diverging step 1 of 5. The strongest olive end. 6.02:1 on white.

2.$description: Diverging step 2 of 5. The lighter olive side. 3.18:1 on white.

3.$description: Diverging step 3 of 5. The neutral centre: no difference.

4.$description: Diverging step 4 of 5. The lighter magenta side. 3.20:1 on white.

5.$description: Diverging step 5 of 5. The strongest magenta end. 6.02:1 on white.

periwinkle.$description: Magnitude, from the lowest value (1) to the highest (5), in periwinkle.

display.$description: The largest heading, for hero titles.

h1.$description: Heading 1: the page title, one per page.

h2.$description: Heading 2: major sections of a page.

h3.$description: Heading 3: the third heading level in a page outline.

h4.$description: Heading 4: the fourth heading level in a page outline.

h5.$description: Heading 5: the fifth heading level in a page outline.

h6.$description: The smallest heading; Alert's title builds on it.

subtitle.$description: Subtitle: a short line under a heading.

body.$description: Body text: paragraphs and input values. The default text style.

small.$description: Small text: secondary copy and compact controls.

overline.$description: A short uppercase label above a heading.

caption.$description: Captions: helper text, metadata and image captions.

label.$description: Form labels for fields such as TextField and Slider.

fast.$description: Quick responses to input: hover, press, focus and small indicators.

slow.$description: The longest duration (P6): larger movements, such as a Sheet sliding in.

instant.$description: No duration: changes that should happen at once, such as movement under reduced motion.

moderate.$description: The default duration for state changes and short movements, such as a menu opening.

standard.$description: Easing for change on screen: something moving or resizing in place.

decelerate.$description: Easing for things arriving or responding: entrances, hover and press.

accelerate.$description: Easing for things leaving: exits and dismissals speed up as they go (decision 0037).

feedback.$description: Fill and text colour responding to hover and press: buttons, chips, tabs and rows.

focus.$description: How the focus ring appears: outline and outline offset.

press.$description: Small movement or fade in response to input, such as a pressed control shifting.

sm.$description: How far a small element travels as it enters, such as a Dropdown menu dropping in.

sticky.$description: Stacking layer for chrome that stays visible while scrolling: sticky headers, navigation bars.

dropdown.$description: Stacking layer for menus anchored to a control: Dropdown and SearchField lists.

overlay.$description: Stacking layer for panels that slide over the page and their backdrop, such as Sheet.

modal.$description: Stacking layer for blocking dialogs and their backdrop: Modal, ActionSheet.

none.$description: No rounding: tables, dividers and sharp-edged containers.

xs.$description: Minimal rounding: small badges, checkboxes, compact tags.

sm.$description: Subtle rounding: buttons, inputs and other form controls.

md.$description: Standard rounding: cards, dropdown menus, popovers.

lg.$description: Generous rounding: modals, action sheets and feature cards.

xl.$description: Large rounding: pill buttons and prominent search bars.

2xl.$description: Extra-large rounding: hero elements and decorative containers.

3xl.$description: Maximum rounding short of a circle: decorative cards and marketing elements.

full.$description: Fully round: avatars, round icon buttons, status dots and chips.

400.$description: Space between groups of elements, around a small Divider, and inside containers.

600.$description: Space between blocks, and around a medium or minimal Divider.

800.$description: Space between sections, and around the default Divider.

1200.$description: Space between major sections, and around an extra-large Divider.

xs.$description: Tightest padding inside a component, such as around an icon in a small control.

sm.$description: Small padding inside a component: chip sides, icon-to-label gaps, compact buttons.

md.$description: Medium padding inside a component: form field insides, medium IconButtons.

lg.$description: Large padding inside a component: button and input sides, card insides.

xl.$description: Generous padding inside a component, such as a prominent call to action.

2xl.$description: Largest padding inside a component: large cards, spacious form sections.

0.$description: No space, for explicit resets of padding, margin or gap.

100.$description: The tightest gap, such as between a label and its required indicator.

200.$description: A small gap, such as between a field's label, control and helper text.

300.$description: The default gap between related elements in a group.

500.$description: Generous padding inside larger containers and cards.

700.$description: A larger step between blocks and sections; pick the step the layout needs.

900.$description: A larger step between blocks and sections; pick the step the layout needs.

1000.$description: A larger step between blocks and sections; pick the step the layout needs.

1400.$description: A large step between page sections; pick the step the layout needs.

1600.$description: A large step between page sections; pick the step the layout needs.

2000.$description: A very large step between page sections, second only to the largest.

2400.$description: The largest gap between page sections, such as FeatureBlock at wide breakpoints.

base.$description: The page: the off-white background everything else sits on (decision 0006).

raised.$description: Content raised off the page: cards, inputs, sheets, dialogs, code blocks.

scrim.$description: Backdrop behind a modal surface: Modal, Sheet, ActionSheet.
